description_en: Modifies the status of an application whitelist policy
description_zh: 修改应用白名单策略状态
name: UpdateWhiteListStrategyStatus

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains this value
parameters.help_zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：

- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The policy ID.
>Call the [DescribeWhiteListStrategyList](~~DescribeWhiteListStrategyList~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
策略编号。
>调用[DescribeWhiteListStrategyList](~~DescribeWhiteListStrategyList~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: strategy_ids

parameters.help_en:
The policy status. Valid values:
- **0**: Deleted.
- **1**: Learning.
- **2**: Paused.
- **3**: Learning complete.
- **4**: Active.

> - Only a policy in the **Learning** state can be changed to the **Paused** state.
> - Only a policy in the **Paused** state can be changed to the **Learning** state.
> - Only a policy in the **Learning complete** state can be changed to the **Active** state
parameters.help_zh:
策略状态。取值：
- **0**：删除
- **1**：学习中
- **2**：暂停
- **3**：学习完成
- **4**：已生效

> - 只有**学习中**状态才能修改为**暂停**状态。
> - 只有**暂停**状态才能修改为**学习中**状态。
> - 只有**学习完成**状态才能修改为**已生效**状态
parameters.name: status
